parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a restraint marker that triggers the sample-app-mirror rule regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The canonical production implementation of 'DebugMetricsProvider.handleDisplayLinkTick' resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package 'DebugPanel'). The copy in 'DebugHUD.swift' is a deliberate self-contained mirror inside the sample app, which avoids coupling the WallpaperSampleApp example target to the DebugPanel production package. Lifting the sample-app copy into shared code would introduce an undesirable production-to-sample-app dependency inversion.
